        <service
            android:name=".LegacyAccessibilityService"
            android:label="Operit2 增强版 UI 自动操作"
            android:permission="android.permission.BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE"
            android:exported="true">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService" />
            </intent-filter>
            <meta-data android:name="android.accessibilityservice"
                android:resource="@xml/legacy_accessibility_service" />
        </service>
        <receiver android:name=".LegacyWorkflowReceiver" android:exported="true">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="app.operit.LEGACY_WORKFLOW_EVENT" />
                <action android:name="app.operit.LEGACY_TASKER_EVENT" />
                <action android:name="com.ai.assistance.operit.TRIGGER_WORKFLOW" />
            </intent-filter>
        </receiver>
